```sql
SELECT

    hs.arr
FROM

JOIN
```

```python
import sqlite3

        cursor.execute("SELECT hc.status, hs.arr FROM customers c INNER JOIN health_status hc ON c.id = hc.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'CUST-0001'")
```
